item.text: The first intervention—removing one repetition-associated MLP neuron—improved accuracy by 6.25 percentage points on 32 paired problems, but its 4.35-point standard error makes that evidence inconclusive. The activation analysis suggests that this neuron is only one contributor to a broader repetition-related direction in layer 19. I will now test removing that single direction from layer 19’s MLP output; a larger accuracy gain accompanied by fewer repetitive cutoffs would support this mechanism.
